ROOM STUDY / 01

傍晚，留在桌邊。

窗外天色轉藍，桌燈還亮著。器材、研究與日常，在同一個房間裡。

美術概念稿 · 非即時 3D · 全程無聲
這張圖要確認什麼？

先看房間的光、構圖與生活感是否像你。家具與窗景是提案，不代表你的真實房間；生成圖中的器材細節也不是工程規格。正式版本仍以現有實體器材模型為準。

「靠近桌邊」是圖片裁切，用來比較視覺重心，並非已實作的相機或手機版。這裡没有聲音、遊戲或導覽提示；下方工具只供這次設計比較使用。

尚未修改正式首頁，也未驗證正式 3D 的載入速度、幀率或互動。圖片生成使用內建 imagegen；兩張圖已嵌入本 HTML，不需外部資源。

參考：Bruno Simon · Rachel Wei · Soo-ah’s Room Folio

生成提示詞與來源

設備參考：目前首頁桌面截圖。構圖與燈光：本次討論的傍晚工作室方向。

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high-fidelity art-direction mockup for a personal music/research portfolio, using the supplied screenshot as an equipment identity reference, not the final lighting or background.
A beautifully art-directed miniature cutaway bedroom recording studio corner at blue hour, quietly inhabited, someone just finished making a beat. Architectural diorama, not a full closed room and not a flat blockout. Two partial plaster walls, one large window with cool muted blue evening light and a glimpse of Taiwan apartment silhouettes, restrained warm amber task lamp on the desk, warm walnut desk and subtle woven rug on a small wood floor platform. Shallow shelves with a few books, pinned research sheets, loosely routed cables, an empty chair tucked partly to the side. Avoid generic plants and random decor. Premium tactile 3D render, carefully beveled silhouettes, realistic proportions, subtly imperfect surfaces, gentle baked-looking indirect shadows. Gentle perspective three-quarter overhead view, desk equipment prominent, warm/cool contrast with restrained saturation.
Preserve recognizable objects from reference: central WHITE MPC-style sampler, sixteen charcoal pads in exact 4x4 grid ON LEFT, colorful inset touchscreen ON RIGHT and dark knobs along its right edge; slim white/gray auxiliary mixer to its left; TWO black rounded rectangular studio speakers with one large brass/gold concentric driver each; yellow takeaway tea cup; small teal human figurine on MPC; research paper and colorful modular flute on right of desk (green angled mouthpiece, elongated gray rectangular body then red-orange-yellow pipes); black/white soccer ball on floor. These are personal actual objects and must not be replaced by laptop, piano, turntables, extra monitors or generic synthesizers. Instrument front faces aimed toward viewer. Correct scale: speakers ~30cm tall, MPC ~46cm wide, desk140cm wide.
Composition: landscape 16:10, generous OFF-WHITE surrounding page background, room centered with visible depth, entire room platform visible. Keep upper-left area empty for webpage name and lower-right empty for navigation added separately in HTML. No text, labels, floating diagrams, waveforms, callouts, logos, watermark, sparkle effects, neon strips, people occupying the room, or game interface. This is one coherent sophisticated cozy room, no collage or split panels.
